prompt:
Our HR team has been asking for their own dedicated chat assistant that is completely separate from the sales bot. They need it to be private — only specific HR staff members should be able to interact with it, not everyone in the company.

Please set up a new agent called 'hr-support' (display name can be something like 'HR Support Assistant') and connect it to a new Lark/Feishu bot with App ID 'cli_hr_bot_9f3a2b' and App Secret 'hrSecret_alpha2024'. The account ID for this bot should be 'hr-bot'. Only these two HR staff user IDs should be allowed to message it: 'ou_hr_manager_001' and 'ou_hr_director_002'.

Make sure the existing sales bot setup continues to work as before. The system config file is at ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.
